lines.zh: 三只烈焰人一起飘过来
它们叠在一起，像一座塔
上面两只抓着下面那只
lines.en: The upper two cling to the lower one.

lines.zh: 火苗随着移动一路掉火星
它们的烟在空中留下三道
lines.en: Three trails of smoke mark their path.

lines.zh: 三根棒子在火里慢慢转
lines.en: Three rods turn slowly in the flame.

lines.zh: 它们一侧身，火星全散开
lines.en: They turn and sparks fly wide.

lines.zh: 它们漂过岩浆，像在水上
lines.en: They drift over lava as if over water.
They bear down on you from above.
Flame binds them into one shape.

lines.zh: 它们的高低起伏几乎同步
lines.en: Their rise and fall stay in step.

lines.zh: 三只烈焰人叠着，静静燃烧
lines.en: Three blazes stack and burn quietly.
Flame licks from the middle to the top.
The lower one turns its head.
The upper two turn with it.
Sparks land on the ground nearby.

lines.zh: 然后又升回原来的高度
lines.en: Then rise back to their height.

lines.zh: 三只烈焰人一起转向你
lines.en: All three blazes turn to you.

lines.zh: 它们的火光同时亮了一档

lines.en: The top one lowers its head.

lines.zh: 它们的火焰朝你那边偏

lines.en: They seem to be judging height.

lines.zh: 它们把叠成的塔压得更紧
它们的目光一起落在你身上
lines.en: Their stares land on you together.

lines.zh: 火焰缩了一下，又涨回来
lines.en: The flame shrinks and swells again.

lines.zh: 三只散开半格又叠回去
lines.en: They scatter half a block and restack.
The fire cannot gather for a moment.

lines.zh: 然后三团火重新亮起来
它们盯着你手里的东西
lines.en: They eye what you are holding.
They care only for more fire.
They look back to your hands.

lines.zh: 你撞上它们，被烫得退开
lines.en: You hit them and recoil from the heat.
Flame washes over you and scatters.

lines.zh: 三只烈焰人被撞得散了一下
lines.en: The three are knocked slightly apart.

lines.zh: 它们退开半格，重新排队
lines.en: They back half a block and reform.
Their flames merge into a larger one.
They brighten and dim in turn.

lines.zh: 偶尔有火星从缝里迸出
它们一起升高又一起落下
lines.en: They rise and fall as one.

lines.zh: 烟的走向都变成了一个

lines.en: They burn like that a long while.
Then the fire splits back into three.

lines.zh: 它们各自回到自己的位置
它们用火烧着把东西夹起
lines.en: They lift the item with flame.

lines.zh: 东西在它们手里烧红了
lines.en: It glows red in their grip.
It is raised to the top one.

lines.zh: 它们把东西烧软了再拿
lines.en: They soften it with heat before taking it.

lines.zh: 它们把战利品收进火里
lines.en: They draw the prize into the fire.
Then they turn back to you.

lines.zh: 它们的火舌伸到你面前
底下的那只开始冒浓烟
它们的火光连成一条线
它们把注意力全压在你身上
lines.en: All their attention presses on you.
The fire sounds like a bellows.

lines.zh: 它们已经对准了你的位置
lines.en: They are aimed at where you stand.
The three fires part and close.
The upper two probe in turn.

lines.zh: 地面的石头被烤得发红
lines.en: Stones on the ground glow red.
They back off and take another angle.

lines.zh: 它们的高度一直压得很低
底下的那只贴地滑过来
lines.en: The bottom one skims the ground.

lines.zh: 你听见三处火焰同时响
lines.en: You hear fire from three sides.

lines.zh: 它们把距离压到了三格
lines.en: They have closed to three blocks.
The top one slams a hand down.
The bottom one butts your legs.

lines.zh: 火焰把你的护甲烤得发烫

lines.en: They split to hit both sides.
After the strike they stack up again.

lines.zh: 它们轮流出手，从不间断
一只烧你的袖子，一只撞你的背
lines.en: One burns your sleeve, one hits your back.

lines.zh: 火焰把地面烧出一圈黑
lines.en: The ground blackens in a ring.

lines.zh: 它们退开半格，重新叠好
lines.en: They back half a block and reform.
Three fires still glow in the smoke.
Three fires form in the air.
They land stacked in a column.
The fire bakes the soil around.

lines.zh: 火星从它们身上往下掉

lines.en: They turn half around to face you.
They rise a little, then settle.

lines.zh: 三根棒子同时转了一下
它们的声音像远处的炉膛
lines.en: They sound like a distant furnace.

lines.zh: 底下的那只先动了一下
火焰互相吞了一口，更旺了
lines.en: The flame eats the flame and grows.

lines.zh: 水汽炸开，火焰骤然变暗
lines.en: Steam bursts out and the fire dims sharply.

lines.zh: 箭穿过火焰，熄灭在半空
lines.en: An arrow passes through the flame and burns out.

lines.zh: 怪力压下来，火焰被压低
lines.en: Odd force presses the flames down.

lines.zh: 火势弱了，三团都缩小了
lines.en: The fire weakens and all three shrink.
Lightning makes the flame burst outward.

lines.zh: 虚空抽走热气，火焰被拉长
lines.en: The void draws off the heat and the flames stretch.
